findings.claim: In crates/xpile/src/main.rs, is_shipped_bound_pilot inspects metadata: for quorum_semantic: shipped-bound; when present, count_field_occurrences counts shipped_binding: instead of lean_theorem: for the Semantic stratum.

In crates/xpile/tests/quorum_semantic_pilot_witness.rs, check_pilot derives the bound theorem set from the Lean pin block's transitive closure over in-file defs, asserts bijection (derived == declared) against YAML shipped_binding annotations, and verifies that each test reads the pin block header.

In crates/xpile/tests/quorum_semantic_pilot_witness.rs, red_stripping_the_marker_restores_the_old_reimplementation_count asserts that stripping the pilot marker restores the old reimplementation count (C-PY-INT-ARITH 42 -> 3) and only pilot contracts change; the CLI text and JSON report disclose the pilot rule.

In crates/xpile/tests/quorum_semantic_pilot_witness.rs, every_quorum_count_a_live_doc_quotes_is_what_the_binary_prints validates live markdown docs against binary output, and red_a_doc_quote_the_binary_no_longer_prints_is_refused proves stale quotes are rejected.

structured_output.summary: The diff strictly implements all acceptance criteria of PMAT-2163 without weakening existing gates or exceeding scope. Pilot contracts (C-PY-INT-ARITH and C-BASHRS-POSIX-IDEMPOTENCE) count only shipped_binding obligations for Semantic votes, while non-pilot contracts retain the existing rule. The witness suite enforces bidirectional derivation against Lean pin blocks, provides RED test arms verifying count restoration when markers are removed, and guards live docs against stale quorum citations.
